label: Water-drop Shape Patch
description: The water-drop shaped lower patch pocket is an exceedingly rare, avant-garde construction in which the patch is cut to resemble a teardrop: the upper portion is narrow and upright, widening gradually toward a rounded lower body. This creates a distinctive organic silhouette on the hip that references natural forms rather than geometric tailoring conventions. It is found almost exclusively on highly individual bespoke commissions from creative Italian or contemporary tailors who treat the jacket as a canvas for sculptural expression.
